scenarios.title: Engineering revision stops before production
scenarios.intentionalFault: The new Control Plan revision retains a downstream Process Flow and PPFMEA from the prior drawing revision.
scenarios.restoration: Restore the downstream revision and child-table snapshots captured by setup evidence.

scenarios.title: Evidence-complete support handoff
scenarios.intentionalFault: An enabled customization produces a repeatable mismatch with a captured Error Log.
scenarios.restoration: Disable only the namespaced demo customization and delete the namespaced support draft after approval.

scenarios.title: Customization-aware guidance
scenarios.intentionalFault: A namespaced validation rule blocks a transition using a business-specific message.
scenarios.restoration: Remove the namespaced validation rule after its before-hash is verified.

scenarios.title: v15 to v16 migration diagnosis
scenarios.intentionalFault: A namespaced script or report references a removed v15 schema surface.
scenarios.restoration: Reinstate the namespaced legacy reference for repeat recording or remove it after the corrected path is verified.
